svg.title: Bellwether 4-route regulatory RFI triage and subsidiary governance flow
svg.desc: An incoming regulator questionnaire is scoped to a specific legal subsidiary, checked for active 24-hour or 4-hour incident reporting triggers, and routed into Route A (Local Direct), Route B (Local Answer with Corporate Evidence), Route C (Corporate Standard Position), or Route D (Privileged Legal Escalation blocked from vector indexing).
